evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: We present the High Energy Physics Tool-and-Agent Benchmarking (HEPTABench) framework for portable and controlled evaluations of agentic systems, with separately configurable tasks, scaffolding, models, providers, harnesses, and domain capabilities.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: To support inspection, reproducibility, and post-hoc grading, the framework prioritizes recording and reporting complete experiment specifications, agent trajectories, and experiment artifacts.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: The first campaign evaluates a forward long-lived-particle reach calculation across four frontier coding-agent systems, comparing their built-in coding tools with the same tools supplemented by HEP domain tools.
